scope: Controlled graphical host and directly tested local presentation/storage components, not a complete Atoll fork. No DynamicNotch source has been copied into this host.

files.modifications: Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Read-only IOKit power-source adapter: copies the power-source list and returns the internal battery; IOPSNotificationCreateRunLoopSource on the main run loop only while enabled, removed and invalidated on stop. No permission, entitlement or network use.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. In-memory internal-battery reading parsed from IOKit power-source descriptions (rejects other sources and implausible values), notice rules (plug in/out, low at 20% and 10% once per crossing, charged including optimized-charging stops; first reading after start is quiet) and the injected-environment BatteryController lifecycle (single observation, stop forgets readings).

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Read-only EventKit adapter: full-access status/request, calendars and events for visible calendars only (bounded to 500), store created only while enabled; observes EKEventStoreChanged, day change, time-zone change and wake; one-shot timer to the next boundary; opens events in Calendar via ical:// and validated meeting links on explicit action. Notes/location read only in memory for meeting-link detection.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. In-memory agenda model (today with all-day first, next timed event, local-day boundaries, next refresh at the soonest boundary or midnight, https-only known-host meeting links, cleaned titles) and the injected-environment CalendarController lifecycle (access states, single access request, hidden calendars never read, generation-guarded timers, stop clears everything). Upcoming event on a later day (timed or all-day) within a 30-day lookahead, and natural day labels.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Injected-environment capture lifecycle: one capture at a time, permission gating without hiding islands, hide/restore exactly once on success, cancel and failure, error classification without image contents. Window/display capture (0.4.0): selection returns a CaptureTarget (region or window) passed through to capture.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Pure region-selection math: drag normalization, clamping to the starting display, minimum size, AppKit-to-Core-Graphics global coordinate conversion. Inverse Core Graphics-to-AppKit rect and point conversions for window highlighting and hit-testing.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Carbon RegisterEventHotKey wrapper for the Control-Shift-4 capture shortcut; receives only its own combination, no Accessibility or Input Monitoring permission; explicit register/unregister.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Propagate hover preference changes to existing display presenters immediately. M2 capture increment (0.2.0): capture shortcut lifecycle tied to start/stop and its setting; capture flow wiring, island hide/restore, peek after capture, Copy/Remove/Clear, thumbnails, status messages, and export cleanup at launch and every 30 minutes while running. Drag-out increment (0.3.0): selection state, drag flow wiring to ShelfStore.beginFileDrag/endDrag, shelf hold across presenters, export-capacity messages. Wire capture targets. M3 Spotify increment (0.5.0): persisted settings, Spotify feature switch starting/stopping the controller, Media/Shelf tab, explicit Open Spotify and Automation settings actions, refresh on expansion. M3 Calendar (0.6.0): Calendar switch and hidden calendars persisted, controller start/stop, Calendar tab with fallback when a feature is turned off, access/settings/open/join actions. Publishes the upcoming event. M4 battery (0.7.0): battery switch and alert choices persisted, controller start/stop with the app and switch, notices sent to every visible island except during capture. 0.7.1: album-artwork switch persisted; loader follows the current track only while Spotify and artwork are on and stops with either.

Adapted getClosedNotchSize measurement ideas into pure display inputs and screen-relative layout; added external floating capsule placement and size bounds. Test-driven fix: preserve menu-bar clearance by bounding panel height below its top edge; compress margins on synthetic tiny frames. Menu-bar clearance: place both complete window rectangles below the maximum safe-area, visible-frame and explicit menu-height band; bound compact/expanded bodies to usable space, and reject unusable geometry. Camera width is metadata, not a content spacer. Notch-sized placement (0.1.3): replaces the below-menu-band placement, which covered application content. On notched displays the compact window equals the public camera-housing rectangle at the top edge, which holds no menus or status items; implausible housing metadata falls back to a bounded width. Non-notched displays use a small pill inset inside the menu-bar center. Only the user-opened expanded state extends across the menu row; expanded content starts below the housing. Battery activity (0.7.0): activity size widening the compact island by equal wings beside the camera housing (or a longer pill), same height, bounded to the display.

files.modifications: Adapted nonactivating panel configuration; replaced upstream managers with per-display presenter and shared local coordinator; removed capture/defaults registration and global services. Extracted original local presentation state into separately tested IslandPresentation.swift. Hover responsiveness: one stable native tracking host per panel, reconcile the actual cursor after events/show/resize, stop tracking before hide/close, and apply preference changes immediately. Refresh public screen/status-bar geometry on show/update/expansion and hide an unusable layout before activating native tracking; menu-row pixels contain no island window. Notch placement (0.1.3): panel level above status items so an open island draws over the menu row; explicit mouse-event receipt for the visually empty notch target; pointer reconciliation includes the display's top edge. Peek entry point for post-capture acknowledgement. Hold entry point that reconciles the pointer before release. Expansion notifies the coordinator (shelf preparation and Spotify refresh). Battery activity (0.7.0): resize to the activity frame while a notice shows; showActivity only on visible, tracking panels.

files.modifications: Extracted locally written presentation state from panel controller; injectable cancellable delay scheduler and stale-callback guard for deterministic race tests. Hover responsiveness: deduplicate unchanged pointer/preference inputs; use 80ms entry and 120ms exit waits; immediately cancel disabled hover work and reset hidden presenters. Peek state: opens briefly, held while the pointer is on it regardless of hover setting, closes after pointer exit, never disturbs an open shelf. Hold state for outgoing drags: pointer exit and hover changes deferred while held, re-evaluated on release; reset on suspend. Battery activity (0.7.0): short notice state with its own stale-guarded timer; ignored while open, ended by opening, peeking, hover-opening or suspension.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Remembered on/off settings as one bounded JSON value in the app's own preferences; tolerant per-field decoding; injectable storage. No personal content stored. Calendar switch and bounded, de-duplicated hidden calendar identifiers. Battery switch and alert choices. Album-artwork switch (off by default).

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Native presenter owns hover events; SwiftUI content animation shortened to 120ms, respecting Reduce Motion. Move compact tray/Shelf/count content below the system menu band and remove camera-gap and extra notch-height content padding. Notch placement (0.1.3): compact notch state draws no visible content; non-notched compact state is a tray/count pill; expanded content is inset below the camera housing. Shelf tiles with thumbnails, time, Copy/Remove; Capture and Clear header buttons; status message line. Tile drag overlay, selection highlight and selected accessibility trait. Capture button and empty-state text describe region, window and screen capture. Media/Shelf tabs and Media content: track, extrapolated progress via TimelineView, controls, and explicit states for not running, permission needed/denied and no track. Draggable playback scrubber with keyboard/VoiceOver adjust; play/pause symbol swaps without animation; progress view no longer rebuilt on play-state changes. Media/Calendar/Shelf tabs from available features; Calendar content with next event, today's agenda, Join for validated meeting links and explicit access states. Calendar tab always shows a Today section ("No events" when empty) and, once today has nothing left, a Next event section with its day. Battery activity wings (icon left, percentage right, center clear for the camera) and battery level with time estimate in the open island header. 0.7.1: battery glyph fills its whole outline and is colored (green plugged in; green/yellow/orange/red by level on battery), bolt contrasts with the fill; optional album cover beside the track with a placeholder.
Retained production drawing implementation and license header; added provenance and removed editor-only #Preview block.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Generic drag lifecycle: one outgoing drag at a time; every prepared core drag session ended exactly once after drop, cancellation, failed start or mouse release during preparation; shelf held open meanwhile; failures reported without contents.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. AppKit NSDraggingSource overlay for shelf tiles: click selects, drag prepares core exports then starts a native copy-only drag with a file URL and in-memory PNG data per item; ends the flow when AppKit ends the session.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Platform adapter: Spotify's PlaybackStateChanged distributed notification and Spotify launch/quit only; Apple Events only to com.spotify.client using its own dictionary codes (playpause/next/previous, player state/position, current track id/name/artist/album/duration), 2-second timeouts on a background queue, AEDeterminePermissionToAutomateTarget for the Automation prompt; never launches Spotify. Permission is requested for the specific core/getd event, because wildcard codes never show the Automation prompt. Permission is now probed with a real player-state read: never-interact to check quietly, a normal send with a long timeout to show the Automation dialog. AEDeterminePermissionToAutomateTarget was removed after it blocked indefinitely on the user's Mac. Every call runs under a hard deadline. Seek via core/setd of the writable player position; 700 ms settle before confirming a command. 0.7.1: artwork lookup (track ID and artwork URL via Apple Events under the same deadline) and an ephemeral, cookie-free, cache-free, redirect-refusing download from the validated image host, limited to 2 MB and image MIME types.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Artwork URL validation (https on i.scdn.co only, no credentials or other ports, bounded length), accepted image types, and the injected-environment SpotifyArtworkLoader: one lookup per track with a single retry when Spotify still reports the previous track, generation-guarded so a slow earlier cover never replaces the current one, size-bounded, memory only, cleared on stop.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. In-memory now-playing model, Spotify notification/scripting parsing (duration in milliseconds, position in seconds, bounded control-free text), extrapolated position, and the injected-environment SpotifyController lifecycle (start/stop observation, generation-guarded replies, permission states, commands). Deadline helper: blocking platform work on its own thread with a fallback at the deadline; late results are discarded exactly once. Only one permission request is in flight at a time; stop clears it. Seek command (clamped to the track); optimistic play/pause and seek shown before sending; confirmation after a settle delay and only for the latest command; unexpected send failures re-read the real state.
